summary: Google DeepMind introduces SL2T, a multilingual sign-language-to-text translation model, and rolls out sign-to-text dictation features in Gboard and Live Transcribe on the Pixel 11, starting with American Sign Language.

practices.reason: SL2T shows a large jump in zero-shot sign-language translation quality, relevant to teams building accessibility or multimodal perception features but not a general-purpose capability most platforms depend on.
practices.quote: SL2T achieves a remarkable zero-shot score of 70 BLEURT, which is significantly higher than any previously reported score.

practices.reason: The FLEURS-ASL benchmark and BLEURT scoring approach describe how the lab measured translation quality, useful context but an internal, lab-run evaluation not directly transferable to other teams.
practices.quote: SL2T is the most capable sign language translation model to date according to key benchmarks like FLEURS-ASL (sd-test), which assesses ASL to English translation quality.
